(adjective) Extremely skilled; of exceptional ability. Origin: Hokkien.
(adjective) Impressive. Origin: Hokkien.
(verb/noun) To have a wardrobe malfunction; an accidental exposure. Origin: Hokkien.
(noun) Girl; woman. Origin: Min Nan.
(adjective) Accurate, spot on. Origin: Hokkien; Mandarin.
(verb) To disturb, ridicule, or tease. Origin: Hokkien.
